grounding.from: ConnexOntario gives free information and referrals for mental health, addiction and gambling services. It's reachable 24 hours a day by phone at 1-866-531-2600 or by web chat.

value.answer: I'm sorry you're looking for that, it's a lot to reach for help with. If things feel urgent right now, ConnexOntario is open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600. For free or low-cost help in Toronto, look at the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program (short-term CBT for adults with depression or anxiety), BounceBack Ontario (free guided self-help if you're 15 or older with mild to moderate anxiety or depression), or Family Service Toronto, which charges sliding-scale fees based on income. For a private therapist, OHIP doesn't cover private practice, but an extended health plan through your employer often does, and your Employee Assistance Program may include a few free sessions a year. Psychotherapy Referral Service is a not-for-profit that has connected people with registered psychotherapists in Toronto since 1995. I couldn't check current wait times, so I can't say how long any of these will take.
